visible_turns.text: The sun is up ! Time for all the campers to rise . Time to get paddling .
Do not worry . Today will be easier .
Call her on my cell phone . Wish her “ Happy Birthday ! ” Tell her you are out exploring the great American wilderness . Tell her I said she is lucky to be born on Independence Day .
Yes , I am lucky . I was born on Christ ’ s birthday . Maybe that is why I usually go to church on Sundays . When is your birthday ?
That is true ! Here , have some Granola for breakfast .
After eating , we will take down our tent . Then we will pack everything into the canoe , We can shove off by 6
How about going for swim around 10
